m6_transfer.revision_diff_and_validity_reason: Six one-for-one commander-first swaps keep 34 lands unchanged, replace Delina's recurring end-combat exile with true one-shot delayed Footsteps/Mimic Vat/Splinter Twin interactions, add Entomb, Zealous Conscripts and Spellseeker; prior turn-stack claims are re-evaluated by all 15 finite positive/negative blueprint cases on the exact approved Oct27 100. The historical M6 blueprint was design-only; no broad full-game engine or retrospective independent I/J certification is implied.

P0.payable_fixture: Commander battlefield/controlled/ready, tappable, and with a pending spell.
P0.positive_assertion: Controlled ready battlefield Obeka ends active player's turn, clearing pending stack.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Unready, off-battlefield, or opponent-controlled Obeka cannot pay activation.
P0.coverage_note: Not a full Comprehensive Rules engine or multiplayer win-rate benchmark; no automatic M6 certification.

P0.payable_fixture: Opponent turn with controlled Obeka and current active player rejecting; own turn accepting.
P0.positive_assertion: Active player acceptance ends the turn and removes liability.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Opponent as active player can decline; Obeka cannot force acceptance.
P0.coverage_note: Not a full Comprehensive Rules engine or multiplayer win-rate benchmark; no automatic M6 certification.

P0.payable_fixture: Footsteps next-end-step sacrifice with end step pending versus already triggered on stack.
P0.positive_assertion: Obeka with delayed trigger on stack permanently removes that one shot.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Skipping before trigger queues it for the next eligible end step.
P0.coverage_note: Not a full Comprehensive Rules engine or multiplayer win-rate benchmark; no automatic M6 certification.

P0.payable_fixture: Mimic Vat one-shot next end step exile versus Delina recurring end-combat exile.
P0.positive_assertion: One-shot queued exile removed once does not recur.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Delina's regular recurring exile reappears each end of combat; removed Delina is not credited.
P0.coverage_note: Not a full Comprehensive Rules engine or multiplayer win-rate benchmark; no automatic M6 certification.

P0.payable_fixture: Final Fortune lose-game trigger with commander removed and unavailable.
P0.positive_assertion: Loss trigger resolves when no payable Obeka activation exists.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Cannot assume Obeka protection through removal or unready source.
P0.coverage_note: Not a full Comprehensive Rules engine or multiplayer win-rate benchmark; no automatic M6 certification.

P1.payable_fixture: Hellkite Courser put commander from command zone with haste, delayed return queued.

P1.adversarial_assertion: Requires actual Courser command-zone/haste text, and only models one-shot delayed trigger.
